$description: Manifest of required normalization capabilities. Each product must implement every variant listed here. Products should validate against this manifest at startup or test time to prevent silent drift.

required_variants.name: NormalizeText
required_variants.description: Idempotent normalization: strip zero-width, decode URL, deobfuscate l33t, remove insertions, collapse whitespace

required_variants.name: stripZeroWidth
required_variants.description: Remove zero-width and invisible Unicode characters (U+200B-U+200F, U+2028-E, U+00AD, U+FEFF, U+2000-A, U+00A0)

required_variants.name: NormalizeSlidingROT13
required_variants.description: Apply ROT13 to individual runs of 4+ alphabetic chars. Returns up to 5 variants. Critical for char_delete_vowels detection.

required_variants.name: NormalizeHomoglyphs
required_variants.description: Replace visually-confusable Unicode with ASCII equivalents

required_variants.name: NFKC
required_variants.description: Unicode NFKC normalization (fullwidth to ASCII, compatibility decomposition)

required_variants.name: NormalizeHexEscape
required_variants.description: Decode hex escape sequences (\xNN to char). Platform/Rampart handle this via NormalizeBackslashEscapes + NormalizeText.

known_misses.reason: float16 precision loss in Conv1D filters
